newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss CPI up 0.5 percent yr-yr in March.
newsitem.headline: Swiss CPI up 0.5 percent yr-yr in March.

text.p: Swiss consumer prices fell 0.1 percent in March from the previous month for a year-on-year inflation rate of 0.5 percent, the Federal Statistics Office said.
Monthly CPI index change -0.1 pct +0.2 pct +0.2 pct
The Federal Statistics Office said the slight monthly decline in March was largely due to a drop in prices of apartment rentals and energy.

Transportation and communication prices also fell, as did those for home furnishings. Prices for entertainment, other leisure, education and cultural activities increased. Prices for food, beverages and tobacco as a group were steady although tobacco prices were higher. Prices of domestic goods were steady on a monthly basis while prices for imported goods fell due to lower prices for oil products.
